zones.review: The accretion panorama already gives the finale a strong identity. Aurora, rainbow continents and city lights weaken its focused gravity story.
zones.progression: The 200-gate finale needs sustained variety without a brighter, busier field. Keep the round solid core unmistakable and leave the real black-hole visual language to the background and portal.
